design: Out-of-family opponents: random-legal, tempo-open (max tiles then openings), anti-minus (public next-hand-size urgency, minimize next legal tile types, otherwise shed pips). Fixed 50/50 and 80/20 min-pips/closed-control priors (20% closed-control in the latter), no oracle profile. Posterior marginalizes each synthetic family across last 3 observed tile-group choices. One public-pass-selected position/deal, same-tile different-end pair. Sample pass-compatible current hands deterministically; reconstruct earlier hands from public played tiles AFTER each observed choice, compute softmax likelihood of chosen tile GROUP (not branch label) under two assumed likelihood families (without knowing true opponent policy). Reweight identical worlds for both candidate next-pass labels. 10% uniform lapse, temperature=1, utility removedPips/3 + 6*mixedFinish - 4*openedDoubles for closed-branch-control. At most 3 most recent opponent play choices per opponent. Compare weighted MC against EXACT pass-only combinatorial posterior. Two disjoint seed halves. Public-history-only predeclared shrinkage/ESS/event guard. Selection uses only first-half labels; untouched second-half holdout. No oracle opponent labels in gate. Exact combinatorial pass-only baseline.
limitations: Out-of-family deterministic bots are not humans. Both 50/50 and 80/20 priors are misspecified by design; synthetic choice likelihood is hypothetical; importance sampling has finite-world variance and potentially low ESS; public selection enriched for informative passes; one publicly selected high-information position per deal; correlated two counterfactual actions; provisional branch number-lock and unresolved block winner/loneZero/bust/101. No human tactic inferred. Training comparisons use a conservative 99% per-candidate cluster bound and margin, not a family-wise guarantee. No human-policy inference. Brier is not game-win rate.
nextAction: Retain exact pass-only if mismatch guard does not improve untouched holdout. Authenticate real branch opening/locking and blocked-round winner; then evaluate paired move regret.

guard.selectionRule: At least 80 non-certain discovery position clusters and 99% cluster lower bound >+0.003 Brier units. Otherwise exact pass-only. Gate never sees actual outcomes or opponent labels.
